title: Assistive Partner Views and Receives Reviews & Ratings - Functional Test Plan
overview: Comprehensive functional testing of the Reviews & Ratings feature on the Y4J AT/AD Vendor Portal.

testCases.title: Verify Reviews & Ratings section is accessible from AP dashboard
Verify dashboard widgets display Average Rating, Total Reviews, and Products Reviewed
Verify Product Reviews section has product search functionality
Verify Product Reviews section sort/filter for All Ratings and Most Reviews
Verify product list shows average rating and total review count per product
Verify clicking a product opens the Product Feedback Summary Page
Verify Product Feedback Summary Page displays all required fields
Verify ratings are automatically recalculated when a new review is submitted
Verify individual review cards display all required information
Verify Customer Reviews sort/filter for All Ratings and Most Recent
Verify review text is limited to 500 characters
Verify in-app notification when a new review is submitted
Verify notification contains only non-sensitive information
Verify APs can only see Approved/Published reviews
Verify AP can respond to approved comments
Verify product page on PwD portal has Reviews tab and catalog ratings
